name: Hernádcéce (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hernádcéce: a red and blue shield with a cross, a chalice and a fish, with a helm, ears of grain as crest and yellow and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed HERNÁDCÉCE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hernádcéce arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
